cohort: Pregnant women divided into three groups based on parity
finding: Primiparas were at increased risk of spontaneous late preterm birth (SLPTB), unplanned cesarean delivery (UCD), and composite adverse neonatal outcome (CANO) compared to multiparas and grandmultiparas.
mod_finding: Primiparas were more likely to have UCD compared to multiparas but not grandmultiparas.
